title: Chemistry-resolved disagreement between PBE and r2SCAN stability verdicts in the GNoME materials database: analysis code and derived results
description:
Analysis code, pre-registered decision rules and derived results for a chemistry-resolved audit of disagreement between PBE(+U) and r2SCAN stability verdicts on the 139,541 GNoME materials released with r2SCAN recalculations.

The repository reproduces from two public CSV files; two phases additionally require a free Materials Project API key, and their outputs are cached and labelled as stored where reused. A driver checks 54 headline quantities against the values printed in the paper and a second layer diffs 242 printed table values against the result files. See REPRODUCE.md for the recipe and REVIEWER.md for the separate question of whether the analysis is correct.
